ambient_events: One of the lamp columns buzzes, thinks about it, and settles.
Somebody has chalked a boat name and a tide on the hut door. Both are months old.
The far lamp picks up the beam off the water and loses it again.
description: Six bays of hardstanding marked out in yellow that has not been repainted since anyone can remember, a kerb on three sides, and a lamp column at each corner of the seaward end. The harbourmaster's hut sits in the corner nearest the water — a bolted steel cabin with one lit window and a sign that has kept its colour better than the paint on the ground. The road is SOUTH; the jetty is NORTH.
name: Jetty Yard
